verses.text: Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim to scout the land. “Go look over the land, including Jericho,” he told them. They went to the house of a sex worker named Rahab and stayed there.
Word reached the king of Jericho: “Some Israelite men came here tonight to scout the land.”
The king sent Rahab a message: “Bring out the men who came into your house. They're here to spy on the whole country.”
But Rahab had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn't know where they were from.
They left after dark, around the time the gate was closing. I don't know where they went. If you hurry after them, you might catch them.”
In fact, she'd taken them up to the roof and hidden them beneath the flax stalks she'd spread out there.
The king's men chased them along the road toward the crossings of the Jordan. As soon as the men left, the city gate was shut.
Before the two men lay down to sleep, Rahab came up to them on the roof.
She said, “I know the LORD has given you this land. We're terrified of you, and everyone who lives here is losing heart because of you.

We heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea in front of you when you came out of Egypt. We also heard what you did to Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings across the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.
As soon as we heard, our hearts sank. Nobody had any courage left to face you, because the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.
So please swear to me by the LORD that, since I've shown you kindness, you'll also show kindness to my father's family. Give me a sign I can trust.
Spare my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and everyone who belongs to them. Save us from death.”
The men told her, “Our lives for yours, as long as you keep quiet about what we're doing. When the LORD gives us the land, we'll be kind to you and keep our word.”
Then she lowered them by a rope through the window, because her house was built into the city wall and she lived there.
She said, “Head for the hills so the men chasing you won't find you. Hide there for three days until they've come back. Then you can go on your way.”
The men said, “Here are the conditions of the oath you had us swear.
When we come into the land, tie this scarlet cord in the window you lowered us through. Bring your father, mother, brothers, and your whole family into the house with you.

If anyone goes out of your house into the street, they'll be responsible for what happens to them, and we'll be clear of blame. If anyone lays a hand on someone inside the house with you, we'll answer for it.
But if you tell anyone what we're doing, we'll be released from the oath you had us swear.”
“Agreed,” she said. She sent them on their way, and after they left she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
The men went into the hills and stayed there three days until the men chasing them had returned. Their pursuers searched all along the road and never found them.
Then the two men came down from the hills, crossed the river, and returned to Joshua son of Nun. They told him everything that had happened.
They said to Joshua, “The LORD really has handed the whole land over to us. Everyone who lives there is losing heart because of us.”
